normalized.recommendation: Do not build now: reserve the slot as a $0.60M option, book the contract molder for 2028, and order the line only once a 2029 service gap and about $3.3M of funding are proven. Reserve the slot as a capped $0.60M option, and release the $4.2M balance only at a June 2027 gate; if either test fails in June 2027, cancel and decide 2030 on signed volume.
